name: haste_any_owner
description: The Hive Hum's haste (design 3.2, contract-m6 3): every tower whose cell centre lies within 2.2 tiles of the hum, whoever built it, fires 15% faster, its cooldown divided by 1.15 (the Lamplighter's arrow every 26 ticks, not 30); a tower farther off is not hastened, and a hum hastens no other hum. The strongest hum applies (a Great Hum's 25%: every 24 ticks), worked out again whenever a tower is built, forked or sold. Help: each hit from a tower another seat's hum hastens is that seat's Help, named haste; the Beekeeper's own Apiary, hastened by her hum, earns her none.

steps.msg: the Lamplighter's arrow beside them is hastened 15%, by the Beekeeper's hum
an arrow three tiles off is not
her own Apiary is hastened too
a hum hastens no other hum
EV_STATUS haste names the hastened tower

steps.assert: fired.size() >= 4 and fired[1][0] - fired[0][0] == 26 and fired[2][0] - fired[1][0] == 26
steps.msg: the hastened arrow fires every 26 ticks
each hit of the hastened arrow is the Beekeeper's Help, named haste
in full: 4 a hit on the Thornback
her own hastened Apiary earns her no Help

steps.assert: t[4].hum_pm == 250 and t[1].haste_pm == 250 and t[3].haste_pm == 250 and t[0].haste_pm == 0
steps.msg: a Great Hum: the strongest applies, 25%, recomputed as it forks
the arrow now fires every 24 ticks
sold, the other hum's 15% holds the arrow again
a tower built beside a hum is hastened as it stands
with no hum left, nothing is hastened
